changelog:
The bar you scroll under is finally glass.

WHAT CHANGED

- The bottom navigation bar now blurs whatever is behind it instead of
  just tinting it. Scroll a list and the rows soften as they pass under
  the bar rather than sliding beneath a flat panel.
- That was the last piece of the design work this version series has been
  building toward, so 0.3.3 is complete.

WHAT DID NOT CHANGE, AND WHY

- The player controls and the screen headers keep their tint and get no
  blur. Video is drawn on its own hardware layer for battery reasons, so
  there is nothing for the app to blur behind the controls, and the screen
  headers sit above their lists rather than over them. Both were checked
  rather than assumed, and adding a blur where nothing is behind it would
  cost something and show nothing.

IF YOU ARE ON AN OLDER PHONE

- The blur needs Android 12 or newer. Below that the bar keeps the same
  colour and simply does not blur; nothing else differs.

STILL WORTH REPORTING

- Opening a poster far down a long scrolled grid: if the artwork appears
  rather than travels into the detail screen, that is the case to tell me
  about.
